name: Rangitoto: The Embodiment of Mahitahi
source:
Four friends steal an egg from a beast. When their fire goes out, the Fire Goddess visits them and gives them a task in which they must work together to restore their fire.

GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/Rangitoto/702279
IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt21207590
translation:
四名好友从一头巨兽那里偷走了一枚蛋。当他们的篝火熄灭后，火之女神降临在他们面前，降下一道考验——四人必须同心协力，方能重燃火焰。
